field.name: mode
field.comment: S: the topics of the topicTreeID tree are listed; P: the ones assigned to the page holding the block are listed

field.name: topicAttributeKeyHandle
field.comment: The handle of the topics attribute of the page holding the topics to be listed (used if mode is P)

field.name: topicTreeID
field.comment: The ID of the topic tree holding the topics to be listed, 0 for none (used if mode is S)

field.name: cParentID
field.comment: The ID of the page that the links of the block point to, where a page list block filters its pages by the chosen topic (0: they point to the page holding the block)

field.name: title
field.comment: The text displayed above the topics

field.name: titleFormat
field.comment: The HTML element wrapping the text displayed above the topics: h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 or p
